using namespace std;

class Task {
public:
    int mod = 998244353;

    int add(int a, int b) {
        int c = a + b;
        if (c >= mod) return c - mod;
        if (c < 0) return c + mod;
        return c;
    }

    int mult(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((long long)a * b % mod);
    }

    int mult(int a, int b, int c) {
        return mult(mult(a, b), c);
    }

    vector<vector<int>> stirling;

    void pre() {
        int size = 5001;
        stirling.assign(size, vector<int>(size, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            stirling[i][0] = 0;
            stirling[0][i] = 0;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            stirling[i][i] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 2; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                stirling[i][j] = add(mult(stirling[i - 1][j], i - 1), stirling[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }

    void solve() {
        pre();
        int n, m, k;
        cin >> n >> m >> k;
        int invm = 1; // placeholder for modular inverse of m
        // Compute modular inverse of m using Fermat's little theorem
        invm = pow_mod(m, mod - 2);
        vector<int> pVal(5001, 0);
        pVal[0] = 1;
        int md = n;
        int prp = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            prp = mult(prp, md, invm);
            md = add(md, -1);
            int sub = prp;
            for (int j = i - 1; j >= 1; j--) {
                int term = mult(stirling[i][j], ((i - j) % 2 == 1) ? pVal[j] : add(0, -pVal[j]));
                sub = add(sub, term);
            }
            pVal[i] = sub;
        }
        cout << pVal[k] << "\n";
    }

private:
    int pow_mod(int base, int exp) {
        int result = 1;
        int b = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) result = mult(result, b);
            b = mult(b, b);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Task t;
    t.solve();
    return 0;
}
